description: Oak National Academy's open curriculum ecosystem, bundled for Claude Code.

plugins.name: oak-open-curriculum
plugins.description: Work with Oak National Academy's live curriculum graph: surface the pupil misconceptions Oak has documented for a topic, and audit a draft plan against how Oak sequences the same units and the prior knowledge each unit states it assumes. Includes Oak's six curriculum principles and its WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility guidance — grounded in real Oak data.
